input.brief: App gratuito que acompanha o estudante de universidade federal do resultado do ENEM/SISU até a formatura: chances com 8 anos de notas de corte, checklist de matrícula, moradia e colegas de república

direction.name: Colour chapters
direction.idea: Every section is a chapter with its own flat colour, floor to ceiling. The page reads like a set of posters hung in a row, held together by one typeface and one grid. The colours are not decoration: they come from the subject (the brand's packaging, the artist's record sleeves, the product's own colour ways, the categories of the content) and each chapter's colour means that chapter. Decide the sequence like a designer orders a book: a strong opener, a quiet second, a surprise in the middle, a dark or very light closer.
direction.composition: Sections are full-bleed fields, each at least 90svh tall, butted directly against each other with no gap and no divider. Inside every field the same 12-column grid and the same margins apply, and each field holds one thing: a huge heading (8–12vw) with a small paragraph, or one photograph with a caption, or one list. Text colour is chosen per field for strong contrast (ink or paper, never grey). Headings start on the same left edge in every chapter, so the eye feels the system as colours change. The navigation and the footer take the colours of the first and last chapter.
direction.typography: One typeface in two weights. Headings very large and tight; body 18–20px. Because colour is loud, the type stays plain: no italics, no second face.
direction.colour: Four to six flat fields used at full strength, one per section, each with its assigned text colour. No tints, no gradients between them: the hard edge where two fields meet is the look.
direction.imagery: Sparing. One photograph or object per chapter at most, either cut out and sitting directly on the colour, or a plain rectangle with generous colour around it. Photographs should be simple enough not to fight the field.
direction.richness: Colour at scale. A whole screen of one saturated colour is rich on its own, so a chapter needs few elements; it still needs its content at full size, because a coloured screen with one small line on it reads as empty.
direction.pitfalls: Check contrast on every field with the palette's assigned ink. Do not put cards on the fields. Do not use more than six colours. Two neighbouring fields should differ clearly in lightness as well as hue.

hero.name: Waterline headline
hero.blueprint: Two flat fields fill the viewport and meet at exactly half height: the upper one paper or white, the lower one a saturated palette colour. No image. The headline is two lines of capitals in a black-weight grotesk at clamp(72px, 9vw, 140px), centred, leading 0.86, about 65% of the viewport wide, positioned so the seam cuts through the middle of the second line. Above the seam the letters take the accent ink; below it they switch to a deep ink, as if under water. Build it with two stacked copies of the headline in the same position (the lower copy aria-hidden), each clipped to its own field with clip-path: inset(), or with mix-blend-mode: difference on a single copy if the colours allow. The wordmark sits top-left and the single action, a solid rectangle in the accent ink, top-right, both on 28px margins; there are no other links. Near the bottom, 40px above the edge, one supporting sentence at 20px is centred in the paper colour on the saturated field. Everything else is empty colour.
hero.mobile: The same two fields, meeting at 46% of the height. The headline sets at 15.5vw on two lines, filling the width inside 16px margins, the seam still cutting the second line. The wordmark sits top-left and the action top-right as a small solid rectangle. The supporting sentence sits bottom-left at 17px on the saturated field, on up to three lines.
hero.headline: A blunt statement of 2-4 words in capitals, at most 20 characters, split so each line is one or two words.

motion.name: Masked headline
motion.description: On load, each line of the headline rises from behind its own baseline, about 900ms with a strong ease-out, the second line 110ms after the first; the supporting sentence and the action then fade up together. Nothing else on the page performs. Because headlines are two lines at most, you author the line breaks and wrap each line yourself. Recipe: 'Masked line reveal' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Drag through the stages
sections.blueprint: A 50/50 split, 88svh tall: two flat fields meeting on a clean vertical edge, and one slider that drives both. Left field: the current stage as a clause of three to six words at clamp(40px, 4.6vw, 76px) on two lines, top-left from column 1, starting with its order word; it serves as the heading. Right field: one fragment of the product at true size, about 440px wide, centred, root marked data-ui, in the state that matches the clause. Along the bottom, crossing both fields inside 28px margins, a real range `<input>` with four stops: a solid track 8px tall, the part already passed in full ink, and a square thumb 32px across in the accent. Under the track, four stage names at 16px, the current one in full ink. Dragging, or the arrow keys, swaps the clause and the fragment's state with a 200ms crossfade; nothing depends on scroll.
sections.mobile: The fragment's field comes first, 46svh, the fragment at true size and cropped to its active region. The slider follows directly beneath on the seam, thumb 40px. Then the clause field: the clause at 9vw on two lines, with the four stage names under it in a two-by-two block at 15px.

sections.name: Output index, live sheet
sections.blueprint: For products that make documents: invoices, reports, emails, statements. Columns 1–5 list the names of three to five outputs, one per line, at clamp(36px, 4vw, 64px), leading 1.1, each a `<button>`; the selected name is in full ink, the rest in the soft ink. There is no other heading. Columns 7–12 are a stage in a flat tone one step from the ground, 88svh tall, and on it lies the selected output as an object: a paper-white sheet 560px wide, built in HTML at true size, root marked data-ui, with a real sender, real line items, sums that add up and a date. The sheet starts 72px below the stage's top and runs past its bottom edge, which crops it. Selecting a name swaps the sheet with a 200ms crossfade; an email is narrower (440px), a receipt narrower still (300px), all left-aligned 64px into the stage.
sections.mobile: Names become one sideways-scrolling row at 22px with scroll-snap, the selected one in full ink. Beneath, the stage fills the width and is 70svh tall; the sheet keeps its true size, anchored top-left with a 16px inset and cropped by the stage's right and bottom edges. Tapping a name swaps it.

sections.name: Rows with margin photographs
sections.blueprint: Everything hangs from one vertical axis at column 5, about 35% of the width. First the heading: a statement of up to five words at clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px) starting on the axis, vertically centred in an otherwise empty 70svh of ground. Then four or five benefit rows, each starting on the same axis: a title at clamp(28px, 3vw, 48px) and under it a paragraph of 34ch at 17px. Columns 1–4 stay empty. At the right margin each row carries one photograph, top-aligned with its title and deliberately unequal: 240px wide at 4:5 in one row, 320px at 3:2 in the next, 180px square after that. Rows are separated by 96–120px of space, not lines. On a saturated field, set all type in one pale ink and leave the photographs ungraded.
sections.mobile: The axis collapses to the left margin. The statement sits at 9vw in 50svh of empty ground. Each row stacks its title at 26px, the paragraph, then its photograph at alternating widths: 100%, 70% flush right, 55% flush left. 64px between rows.

sections.name: Bars standing on the edge
sections.blueprint: The product's own chart, drawn in HTML, is the whole section. A full-bleed field 90svh tall. Along its bottom edge stand ten to fourteen solid bars, one per true value (months, releases, cohorts), in a CSS grid spanning the full viewport width with 8px gaps and no side margins; heights are the values scaled so the tallest is 58vh. No axes, no grid, no legend; the chart's root is marked data-ui. Every bar is one tone two steps from the field except the one the page is about, which takes the accent. Three bars print their value directly above themselves at clamp(20px, 2vw, 30px), tabular. The headline figure sits top-left on the page margin at clamp(88px, 10vw, 168px), and its claim, two to five words at 28px, sits beneath it on the same margin. Hovering or focusing a bar shows its value and period above it.
sections.mobile: Bars run sideways: each a full-width row 28px tall growing from the left edge, 6px gaps, eight values at most. The headline figure sits above at 26vw with its claim at 22px. Three rows print their value at 17px inside the bar's right end. The accent row stays.

sections.name: Wide photo, colour tile, facts
sections.blueprint: Top: a heading of two to four words at clamp(40px, 4vw, 60px) on the left margin, then 24px below it a three-line lead paragraph at 21–22px across columns 1–6. 72px lower, two tiles sit side by side with a 16px gap. The left tile spans columns 1–8: a landscape photograph at 16:10 with one radius (0 or 10px). A short paragraph of up to 35 words at 16px is set in a solid paper-colour block 320px wide with 20px padding, placed over the photograph's top-right corner and flush with both edges. The right tile spans columns 9–12 and is a flat palette colour, 60% of the photograph's height: it holds a simple inline SVG outline of the region or the floor plan as one filled shape, with one solid dot marking the location. Under the colour tile, four label and value pairs at 14px in a two-by-two grid: altitude, distance, season, local time.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9vw, lead at 18px. The photograph goes full width at 4:3 and its overlaid paragraph moves beneath it as ordinary text. The colour tile follows at full width and 3:2, and the four label and value pairs sit under it in two columns.

sections.name: Accordion of filled tiles
sections.blueprint: A two-part row. Columns 1–4 hold the heading, two to four words at about 4vw, `position: sticky; top: 96px` so it stays while the list scrolls past. Columns 5–12 hold the accordion: each question is a filled tile one step from the page ground, with 8px between tiles, no border and the page's one radius (or its motif's corner). A closed tile is 72px tall with the question at 20px medium on the left, 24px padding, and on the right a plus sign drawn from two 3px bars 16px long. The open tile switches to the accent colour with its assigned ink, the plus becomes a minus by rotating one bar, and the answer appears at 17px, no wider than 52ch. Build each tile as `<details>` with a shared `name` so one opens at a time. Six to nine tiles.
sections.mobile: The heading sits above at 9vw, not sticky. Tiles run full width with 6px gaps, questions at 18px wrapping to two lines, closed height at least 64px. The open tile keeps the accent colour, and answers are set at 16px with 20px padding.

sections.name: First step, already open
sections.blueprint: The page ends with the product's first screen already open. A full-bleed field in the accent colour, 90svh tall. Right, in columns 7–11, vertically centred: the product's own create dialog at true size, 440px wide, root marked data-ui, with its real title ('Name your workspace'), one text field holding an editable, believable example, one two-option segmented choice and its primary button. Inside the fragment the product's conventions apply, including the shadow its dialog normally casts. The field accepts typing, the choice switches, and the primary button is the page's only action: it carries the typed value into sign-up. Left, in columns 1–5, anchored to the bottom with 40px margins: the closing line, two to four words at clamp(56px, 7vw, 112px), leading 0.92, on two lines, and under it one sentence at 17px saying what happens after the button. The upper-left stays empty.
sections.mobile: The closing line leads at 13vw on two lines, top-left, with its sentence beneath at 16px. The dialog follows at full width inside 16px margins, at true size, its primary button 52px tall and full width. The field is at least 84svh; the dialog sits in its lower half.

sections.name: Name first, places under it
sections.blueprint: The wordmark opens the footer instead of closing it. On a full-bleed field in the page's inverse or final chapter colour, the name spans the full content width as the first thing, its cap line pushed 8% above the footer's top edge so the tops of the letters are sliced off by the section (`overflow: hidden` and a negative top margin in `em`). 72px beneath, a two-part row: columns 1–5 list the places or ways to reach the studio (cities, or email and telephone), one per line at 32–36px in the accent ink, each a link; columns 7–12 hold three columns of small links at 15px, top-aligned with the first place. A final row 96px lower carries the legal line at the left and a back-to-top text link at the right, both 13px. The field is about 90svh tall, and nothing sits between the wordmark and the row but space.
sections.mobile: The sliced wordmark stays at the top, fitted to the width. Places follow as a list at 26px, then the link columns two across at 15px. Legal line and back-to-top link share the last row at 12px, at opposite margins.

references.name: Paul Kalkbrenner
references.idea: Swiss poster typography for a techno artist: the name as one black line with a photo set inside it like a glyph, then every chapter gets its own flat colour and visible grid.
references.hero: Pure white viewport. The artist's name sits on one line at exact vertical centre in bold black neo-grotesk, about 10.4vw, spanning roughly 78% of the width with equal side margins. The space between first and last name is replaced by a small landscape black-and-white photo, x-height tall and resting on the baseline. Top-left is a tiny circular monogram; eight nav links in 13px bold are spread at even intervals across the right half of the top edge. Bottom edge: equaliser bars with a grey label over a track title at left, a three-line bold blurb starting just left of centre, a sound toggle hard right. About 85% is empty.
references.type: ABC Diatype Plus Variable only: bold at -0.05em tracking for display and 13.5px bold for everything functional. Display runs from 150px in the hero to about 44vw elsewhere per the digest. Tiny uppercase labels inside boxed cells; no second face, no italics.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #c5c5c5 #a7ff9c #ff6831 — Black on white to start, then whole sections flood with flat mid-grey, acid mint and orange. Photos inside coloured sections are tinted to the section hue or kept black-and-white.
references.imagery: Portraits and live shots of the artist: full-bleed colour images between sections, a grainy monochrome portrait marked up as a vinyl disc, a green duotone car portrait, and a strip of small mixed-ratio thumbnails. Square corners throughout.
references.layout: Outer margins of only 4-8px; content hangs on a visible column grid with hairlines and boxed cells. Sections alternate between full-bleed photographs and flat colour fields, each arranged differently, so the rhythm is one poster after another.

sections.description: Two words stacked in bold grotesk at roughly 8vw, each preceded by a solid black circle about the height of the lowercase, the second line indented further right than the first. Thin horizontal and vertical hairlines cross the white field at baselines and column edges like a construction grid. Directly beneath is a single row of streaming-service logos spaced evenly edge to edge, then a full-bleed photograph.

Flat mid-grey field split in two. Left half: a square grainy monochrome portrait with a large thin circle drawn on it and a small grey dot at the centre, so the photo reads as a record. Right half: a row of three year tabs and a small link above a hairline, the album title in small bold caps, a short description lower down, and along the bottom two wide outlined cells side by side acting as buttons.

Acid-mint field introducing the tour list. A large photograph, recoloured as a green-and-black duotone, occupies only the top-right quadrant; the left half is left empty. Along the bottom a table header with three tiny uppercase column labels sits on a hairline spanning the full width, where the list of dates begins.

Orange field. A horizontally scrolling strip of small photographs of differing widths runs across the top, cropped by both edges. Below it one outlined rectangle spans the width, divided into three equal cells: two inputs and a submit action, each identified only by tiny centred uppercase text. Small-print lines sit under the left and right cells.

steal: Replace the space between the two words of a giant name with a small photo cropped to x-height.
Flood each chapter with one flat colour and tint its photograph to match as a duotone.
Build forms and button pairs as adjoining outlined cells with tiny uppercase labels instead of filled buttons.

references.name: Aardvark Book Club
references.idea: A book club dressed as a sweet shop: fat black type, tumbling 3D books and boxes on wavy colour fields, annotated with handwritten asides.
references.hero: A saturated yellow field with two large wavy blobs, pale yellow then orange, rising from the bottom. A three-line headline in Champ Bold, black, at about 8.3vw with leading under 0.85, is flush to a 15px left margin and reaches 60% across. Beneath it: a four-line paragraph 310px wide and a magenta split button (label plus arrow square). Right of centre a 3D hardback in navy and pink tilts 20 degrees, 600px tall; another book is cropped by the top-left corner, a third by the bottom edge. A purple handwritten note sits rotated at far right. Nav: pale-yellow pill links centred, an orange login button, black round social icons.
references.type: Champ Bold, an ultra-heavy wide sans with a looped g, for headings at 120px with tight tracking and leading; Degular for 18px body and pill labels; a purple handwritten script (Hello Organichand) for rotated margin notes and step labels. Three distinct voices.
references.colour: #ffd249 #faed8f #f9a21f #ffdbfd #a4f6f8 #fd48f2 — Each section owns one flat candy colour: yellow hero, white shelf, pink steps, cyan unboxing, deep violet footer. Type stays black; buttons are magenta.
references.imagery: 3D-rendered hardbacks and a patterned shipping box, cut out and tilted, floating over flat wavy vector shapes; real book covers on tilted coloured cards; black line drawings of figures on step cards. Nothing sits square to the grid.
references.layout: Sections are full-width panels with roughly 80px corner radius inset about 20px from the viewport, each a different colour. Headings alternate left and centre; cards overlap and rotate a few degrees; handwritten notes are tucked beside headings at an angle.

sections.description: White band. A centred black heading at 5.5vw over a two-line subline, with a rotated handwritten note at its upper left. Below, a horizontal row of book covers, each on a rounded colour-matched card with a small tag pill at top-left; cards tilt alternately by 3 degrees at staggered heights, the last cropped by the right edge, with two round arrow buttons above at right. Later, covers give way to same-coloured info cards with genre pills, heavy title and blurb.

A pale-pink rounded panel with lighter wavy shapes inside. Heavy black heading at left with a handwritten aside beside it; a small round logo stamp and a magenta split button at right. Along the bottom, four portrait cards about 250px wide in cyan, magenta, yellow and violet overlap like a fanned hand, each rotated a few degrees, with a handwritten step label at top, a black line drawing in the middle and a heavy caption at the foot.

A full-viewport cyan rounded panel containing only a 3D shipping box wrapped in a wavy magenta, violet and black pattern, centred. Across the scroll it goes from closed and tilted to lid open, growing to about 57% of the viewport width, with a single handwritten note at its right. No heading and no button.

The preceding white section ends in large rounded bottom corners over a deep violet footer. Left: white logo, two store badges, two magenta round social icons. Centre: the patterned box again, cropped by the bottom edge. Right: a small heavy heading, a white rounded email field and a magenta split button. A black legal strip closes the page.

steal: Give each section one flat saturated colour inside a large-radius inset panel and keep the type black across all of them.
Add rotated handwritten margin notes beside headings to carry secondary facts in a second voice.
Fan step cards so they overlap and tilt instead of sitting in an even grid.

references.name: PROOOOF
references.idea: The product's output is the page: a wall of photos each wearing its coloured EXIF strip, with all the copy folded into one small floating card.
references.hero: The whole viewport is a six-column masonry of photographs on a warm off-white ground with about 15px gutters, columns offset vertically so rows never line up. Each photo has a flat strip fused to its bottom edge carrying tiny monospaced capture data, every strip a different solid colour (black, red, orange, yellow, violet, green). Dead centre floats a white card about 380px wide and 410px tall with roughly 28px corner radius and a soft shadow. It contains an extended wordmark with chained O's, a two-row accordion with the first row open, an App Store badge and a monospaced line of links. There is no navigation.
references.type: An extended, heavy wordmark with interlocked O's is the only display type. Card text is Wintyr VF at about 14-16px, medium weight for accordion headings. EXIF strips and footer links are monospace at roughly 8-13px. No headline anywhere.
references.colour: #f3eee9 #fafafa #191818 #ff6a2b #f7c531 #5a4fcf — Colour comes from the photographs and the saturated caption strips, one hue per photo. Card and gutters stay off-white; a final panel flips to near-black with grey characters.
references.imagery: Casual travel, food, pet and concert photos in mixed portrait and landscape crops, square corners, ungraded, tiled edge to edge. The page ends on an ASCII-art rendering of a hand holding a camera.
references.layout: Effectively a single screen: the photo wall sits behind a centred card that carries every word. Six columns on desktop, two on mobile where the card widens to nearly full width. The only second scene is a dark, inset ASCII panel.

sections.description: All product copy lives in the centred card as an accordion: a row with heading left and chevron right, a hairline divider, the open panel's four-line paragraph, a centred store badge, another divider, a collapsed second row, then a small monospaced line with a version number and underlined links. The card stays put while the wall remains visible on all four sides.

Each tile is a photo with a data strip attached below: two or three rows of monospaced text, four values spread evenly across the first row, date and time at opposite ends of the second, maker and model on the third. Strip and text colours change per tile, for example yellow on black, black on yellow, white on violet, so a uniform grid looks varied.

The closing panel is a near-black rectangle inset with wide margins and filled edge to edge with rows of grey ASCII characters that resolve into a picture of a hand gripping a camera. One line of tiny monospaced uppercase text sits at the exact centre as the call to action. No button and no logo.

steal: Show the product's output at wall scale as the background and confine all copy to one small card on top of it.
Give every repeated tile its own flat accent colour for the caption strip so a strict grid reads as lively.
Hold the explanatory copy in an accordion inside the hero card so the page needs no scrolling.
